hero.title: Your event, handled end to end
hero.subtitle: From weddings to corporate conferences — we take care of the planning, the styling, the vendors and every detail on the day, so you can simply be present.

home.aboutTitle: 360 degrees means nothing is left to chance
home.aboutBody: We treat every event as a full circle. From our first conversation until the last guest heads home — budget, venue, stage, lighting, catering, guest management — everything sits with one team, one plan and one dedicated coordinator. You never have to chase ten different vendors.
home.pillar1Body: A single named person owns your event and knows the status of every decision and every vendor.
home.pillar2Body: You get a clear cost breakdown up front. No hidden charges, no last-minute surprises.
home.pillar3Body: Colour, light, florals and stage are designed around your story and taste — never lifted from a ready-made template.
home.servicesSubtitle: An intimate gathering or a thousand-guest celebration — we shape the plan around what you actually need.
home.teamTitle: The people who'll run your event
home.teamSubtitle: Planners, designers and on-ground crew — an experienced team that stays calm when it matters most.
home.clientsTitle: People who've trusted us with their day
home.gallerySubtitle: A glimpse of weddings, corporate events and special celebrations.

cta.body: Tell us the date, a rough guest count and what you have in mind. We'll shape the rest of the plan together.

about.title: Good events get noticed. Great ones get remembered.
about.subtitle: 360DEP is an event management company — we plan, we design, and on the day, we run the whole thing.
about.story1: Anyone who has hosted an event knows how many people, decisions and phone calls sit behind it. The decorator on one line, the caterer on another, the sound-and-light crew missing at the last minute. On the day itself, the host never gets to be a guest.
about.story2: 360DEP was built to fix exactly that. We wanted one team that carries the entire event — from finding the venue to designing the stage, planning the menu, seating the guests, and even packing everything away once the night is over.
about.story3: The '360' in our name is that promise — the full circle. We plan intimate family gatherings and large corporate events alike, but the rule never changes: think through every detail in advance, so that on the day you don't have to think at all.
about.mission: To give every client an event that is honest to their taste and their budget — one where they can relax and be a guest at their own celebration.
about.vision: To raise the standard of event management in Bangladesh — where punctuality, transparency and good design are not luxuries but simply what you expect.
about.diffTitle: Why clients come back to us
about.diff1Title: A written plan, down to the minute
about.diff1Body: Every event gets a minute-by-minute run sheet that you, our team and every vendor know well in advance.
about.diff2Body: We only work with vendors whose work we've seen with our own eyes. Quality is never left to luck.
about.diff3Body: Rain, a power cut, a late delivery — the fallback for every likely problem is decided before the day arrives.
about.diff4Title: We're on the ground on the day
about.diff4Body: Our team is present from setup to close. Your phone stays quiet because the questions come to us.
about.processTitle: From the first call to the last goodbye
about.step1Body: An open conversation about your event, your guests, your taste and your budget.
about.step2Body: A clear plan in your hands, with a detailed cost breakdown.
about.step3Body: Theme, décor, vendor bookings and rehearsals — with you in the loop at every step.
about.step4Body: We're on the ground running everything to time. You simply enjoy it.
